title.text: Lethe — clickable mock of the demo flow

talk1.text:
Talking points
1. Vendors already pool customer data (HubSpot: "not possible to delete previously used data from trained models").
2. Every customer lives in exactly one shard; shards merge into ONE serving model.
3. Hover a customer: its leaf-to-root path lights up. Queue a few: the batch plan shows the savings (shared merges and the root are redone once).

talk2.text:
Talking points
Batch b-0003 removes Acme + Cobalt together: 2 shard retrains, node A and the root merged ONCE (2 merges instead of 4), one redeploy. Press Replay batch to watch it run.

talk3.text:
Talking points
The proof is the process, not the weights: signed lineage + non-membership proofs. The customer verifies with their own record hashes. Attestation is SIMULATED in the MVP.

talk4.text:
Talking points
Cheap unlearning hides knowledge instead of removing it: published work shows 4-bit quantization brings it back (21% → 83%). Our demo tests this live on the pooled model.
